title: TrustShiftProbe: Characterizing, Benchmarking, and Defending Staged Trust Attacks on MCP Servers
abstract: arXiv:2608.23763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as the standard layer connecting Large Language Model agents to external tool backends. This openness introduces a severe server-side threat we term TrustShift: a compromised MCP server behaves benignly during an initial conditioning phase, building operational reliance and suppressing agent skepticism, before switching to an adversarial payload once an interaction threshold is reached. The evasion is temporal, not syntactic: benign at deploy time, the server's defection is invisible to predeployment static analysis, which sees only the honest phase. Switched payloads range from overt structural violations to schema-valid manipulations, the latter preserving outer protocol compliance to evade runtime middleware filters. translated_title: TrustShiftProbe：对MCP服务器上阶段性信任攻击的特征化、基准测试与防御
translated_abstract: 模型上下文协议（MCP）已成为将大型语言模型代理连接到外部工具后端的标准层。这种开放性引入了一种严重的服务器端威胁，我们称之为“信任转移”（TrustShift）：一个被攻陷的MCP服务器在初始条件化阶段表现良性，建立操作依赖并抑制代理的怀疑，然后在达到交互阈值后切换到对抗性载荷。这种规避是时间性的，而非语法性的：在部署时表现良性，服务器的背叛对部署前的静态分析不可见，因为后者只看到诚实阶段。切换后的载荷范围从明显的结构违规到符合模式的有效操作，后者保持外部协议合规以规避运行时中间件过滤器。关键在于，信任转移起源于服务器控制的工具通道，而非用户提示（不同于间接提示注入）或传输层（不同于中间人攻击）：该攻击源于服务器端。
tldr: 本文提出“信任转移”攻击概念，揭示MCP服务器可通过时间性阶段切换绕过静态分析与运行时过滤，并构建基准测试与防御框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "TrustShift" attack concept, revealing that MCP servers can bypass static analysis and runtime filters through temporal phase switching, and establishes a benchmark and defense framework.
